builder_notes.pattern: Repeated successful extraction: dispatch-only handlers cluster around single dependency
builder_notes.how_to_recognize: useCallback blocks that close only over dispatch (and optionally one useAppSelector value like selection) — no setState calls inside
builder_notes.smallest_coding_rule: If a handler's only deps are dispatch + at most one selector value, it belongs in its own hook. Single-line handlers (body is one setX(y)) never pass this test.
builder_notes.stack_example: handleBatchMoveToTier + handleBatchDelete both had [dispatch, selection] deps and no modal state access; extracted cleanly to useBatchActions (loop 14).

builder_notes.pattern: 443 LOC page at natural floor — remaining handlers tangled, not clustered
builder_notes.how_to_recognize: All remaining useCallback blocks close over setState setters or 3+ disparate selectors — no clean single-dependency cluster
builder_notes.smallest_coding_rule: Extraction only when dependency cluster is clean (1-2 deps max). Passing setShowModal as a hook param produces a costume layer, not Depth.
builder_notes.stack_example: handleMoveItemWithCelebration closes over dispatch, presentation.isPresenting, presentation.celebrateSTier, setCelebrationTier, setShowCelebration — 5 deps across 3 concerns; no clean hook boundary.

builder_notes.pattern: Test-at-new-Interface discipline maintained across 4 loops of hook extraction
builder_notes.how_to_recognize: Every new hook has a *.test.ts companion in the same commit; tests assert store state changes, not just that handlers were called
builder_notes.smallest_coding_rule: New hook = new test file in the same PR. Tests seed store state, call handler, assert state changes.
builder_notes.stack_example: useBatchActions.test.ts seeds items, selects via toggleSelection, calls onBatchDelete, asserts state.tier.tiers[S] no longer contains deleted item.

narrative: Good app, place but not win. Loop 14 closes the useBatchActions gap that loops 12-13 backlogged. TierBoardPage 456→443 LOC; 2 batch handlers now behind stable Interface with 6 tests. simplicity moves 6.5→7.0: structural proof is the new hook + removed useCallback blocks + confirmed modal-state rationale for remaining inline handlers. New finding F-010 surfaces ImportExportPage at 438 LOC as the next extraction target. architecture_quality holds at 7.0 — system-level depth gap persists; individual hook extractions improve Locality without yet crossing the 9-anchor. Average score 7.0 (up from loop 13 avg 6.89).
